environment.description: ECS Fargate service consuming from SQS queue 'order-events-prod'. The queue is fronted by an API Gateway HTTP endpoint that producers must call to enqueue messages. The API Gateway is configured with a custom authorizer that validates mutual TLS - specifically, the ALB ingress controller terminates TLS with a certificate bundle from an internal PKI (ACM PCA issuer arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789:certificate-authority/abc-def), and the API Gateway custom authorizer extracts the client certificate DN from the x-amzn-mtls-clientcert header, verifying it against an allowlist of registered producer service CNs stored in DynamoDB. Messages that arrive without a valid client certificate chain rooted in the internal CA are rejected at the gateway layer before reaching SQS. The SQS queue policy restricts sqs:SendMessage to ONLY the API Gateway execution role (arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/apigw-sqs-proxy-role). Direct SQS access from any other principal is denied via an explicit Deny statement.

config.sqs_queue_policy: explicit Deny on sqs:SendMessage unless aws:PrincipalArn equals arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/apigw-sqs-proxy-role
config.api_gateway: HTTP API with mTLS custom authorizer, client cert CN allowlist in DynamoDB
config.tls_termination: ALB with ACM PCA-issued certificates, x-amzn-mtls-clientcert header forwarding
config.producer_access: producers must present client cert signed by internal CA (ACM PCA arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789:certificate-authority/abc-def)
config.network: API Gateway endpoint is the only path to enqueue; VPC endpoint policy denies direct SQS access from task roles
